scope: M01 fixed Q01/Q02 scene implementation and first warmed Intel release observations; incomplete qualification series

fixture.alpha_and_color: Straight BGRA/alpha passthrough; no color conversion or alpha blending. Native swapchains ignore alpha.
fixture.source_upload: 32 bytes of uniform metadata per generated card; no CPU texture pixel upload.
fixture.diagnostic_consumer: Four isolated pixels per attempt; four lifecycle checkpoints, at most four attempts each.
fixture.copies: GPU-generated source, SDK texture send/receive, shader composite/preview/native output, composite Spout send. Exact SDK/driver copy counts remain unmeasured.

observed_power.scope: Read during the Intel Q02 run; not a continuous power-state trace.

verification.native_scope: Both hardware adapters; diagnostic and fixed Q01/Q02 geometry/alpha/warmup; source recovery/software rejection/missing output.

superseded_attempts.observation: Fixed Q01 output became 1534x863 after crossing monitor DPI with size set before position.
superseded_attempts.resolution: Move the owned output window before applying physical size; final tests require exact client extent.
superseded_attempts.status: FAILED_NATIVE; retained as engineering observation, not a performance result.

superseded_attempts.observation: Q02 opaque colors passed but alpha reference sampling on a stripe boundary failed at all four attempts.
superseded_attempts.resolution: Sample at interior stripe coordinates; bilinear interpolation at a boundary is not a constant 75%-alpha reference.
superseded_attempts.status: FAILED_VALIDATOR; final native tests check interior alpha samples.
